messages.subject: Frank | Energy, Mining & Utilities Executive | ESG, Government Relations and Global Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Frank,

Your work across Energy, Mining & Utilities and your earlier global energy investment-banking background make this a focused introduction. I am pursuing senior international mandates where resource-sector strategy, institutional relations and responsible growth converge.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My portfolio also includes stakeholder governance around large-scale solar and battery storage and carbon-data readiness. Earlier experience with Scotiabank gives me additional grounding in regulated financial services and risk discipline.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Social Performance and Country Leadership in energy, mining, infrastructure and industrial businesses. I am internationally mobile.

I have attached a TRANSEARCH-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for current or future mandates where this cross-sector profile fits.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
